description: Source code for the NextcloudCookbook class, which integrates recipe import/export functionality, including parsing JSON recipe files, handling images, and managing recipe data models.

classes.name: NextcloudCookbook
classes.description: A class that handles importing and exporting recipes from Nextcloud, extending the Integration base class.

methods.name: import_file_name_filter
methods.description: Filters zip info objects to include only JSON files.

methods.name: get_recipe_from_file
methods.description: Parses a JSON recipe file, creates recipe and related objects, and handles images.

methods.name: formatTime
methods.description: Formats time in minutes to ISO 8601 duration string.

methods.name: get_file_from_recipe
methods.description: Serializes a Recipe object into a JSON string with recipe details.

methods.name: get_files_from_recipes
methods.description: Creates a zip archive of recipes and associated images for export.

methods.name: getJPEG
methods.description: Converts image bytes to JPEG format.

methods.name: getThumb
methods.description: Creates a thumbnail of specified size from image bytes.
